2 community pools

2 bikes!

Charcoal grills

4-star restaurants

Less than 1.5 miles to Seaside

Beachwood 12E by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 In the heart of old Seagrove, welcome to Beachwood 12E, a charming, three-bedroom Beachwood Villas condo. Nearby, take advantage of great dining options with Café Thirty-A, Brozini's Pizza, Angelina's, and The Surfing Deer. Beachwood Villas has lots of amenities to offer, including two large community pools (one heated seasonally) and charcoal grills. Beachwood Villas Beach Access is just a short walk away. Additionally, the property provides two bikes(!) and plenty of parking. Inside, the charming living, dining, and kitchen area has recently been updated. The first bedroom features two full beds and a convenient jack-and-jill style bathroom that exits into the hallway.

The primary bedroom, king, and guest room, queen, are tucked in the back. Step outside onto the extra-large balcony that overlooks the unique landscape and community pool. Book your stay at Beachwood 12E and experience the ultimate vacation getaway. Have fun! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 350 steps to Beachwood Villas Beach Access - 3 bed, 2 bath - 1108 sq ft - Wi-Fi - 2 bikes included Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; private bathroom - Double full in guest room; shared bath - Queen in guest room; shared bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
